DEFINITION · qeva:1:integer@1

Integer

Integers extend natural numbers with additive opposites.

editorialnumber-theory · algebra

PLAIN

The idea

Integers extend natural numbers with additive opposites.

EXACT

The compact statement

One construction takes pairs (a,b)∈ℕ² modulo (a,b)~(c,d) iff a+d=b+c; the class represents a−b.

EXAMPLE

The class of (3,5) represents −2.

BOUNDARY / CAVEAT

The construction and the resulting abstract ring should be distinguished.

ASSUMPTIONS

  • The declared arithmetic construction context is fixed.
